Game Overview

Harvest Store Sorting is a puzzle game built around delight in organizing a bountiful harvest in Harvest Store Sorting. Challenge your puzzle-solving skills by neatly arranging fruits on uniquely shaped shelves. Navigate increasing complexities with intuitive drag-and-drop mechanics, using strategic planning and special tools to overcome tricky situations. Test your sorting prowess in this charming pastoral adventure!
